failure_condition: Mean RETAIL_REC over the following 28 days is not higher than the trailing 28-day mean of -61.8 when RETAIL_REC has risen for four consecutive weekly readings.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS jumped 21.8 points while RESIDENTIAL fell 3.5 points, showing households substituting home time for outdoor activity; this outdoor-leisure channel crowds in trips past retail corridors and lifts RETAIL_REC within two weeks.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days does not exceed its trailing 28-day mean whenever PARKS gains more than 15 points and RESIDENTIAL falls across two weeks.

failure_condition: Mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than the trailing 28-day mean when TRANSIT stays below -50 and WORKPLACES weekly gains stay under 1 point.
